title: Letters from the Vatican and the Orthodox Church about his book

tellings.quote: I've sent my book and gotten letters back from the Vatican and also from from the Orthodox Orthodox Church hierarchy in uh in in Istanbul, Turkey

plain: A man identified only as Ralph, who has written a book, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he sent copies of it to religious leaders. He says he got letters back from the Vatican, the headquarters of the Catholic Church, and from the leadership of the Orthodox Church in Istanbul, Turkey. He tells it to show that his ideas reached, and drew replies from, the highest levels of two great churches.
